analysis: One fixed score intervention after frozen-margin attribution
motivation: All 33 rejected useful new HF candidates at checkpoint 101 have decoder mean log-probability as the largest negative margin component.
intervention: For HF acceptance only, subtract the decoder contribution from the source-versus-existing-beam-winner margin. Keep that beam winner, every coefficient, bank, recording trigger, deduplication and tie rule fixed.
scope: Existing complete CV27 TEST; retrospective scoring sensitivity, not independent confirmation or a proposed final policy.
selection_boundary: One intervention; no threshold search, coefficient refit, new generation, or promotion based on its TEST WER. Keep the original DEV-selected primary method unchanged.
